profileModal.title: User profile
profileModal.description: Personal settings, language and security for your account.
profileModal.wheelHint: Items turn like a drum around the active item while scrolling.
profileModal.accordionHint: Only show the active item expanded.

personalData.description: Download all data hocX has stored about you – as a password-protected ZIP file with an Excel workbook and a machine-readable JSON file.

notifications.description: Which emails you receive from your organization. We deliberately send few: new tasks bundled and one reminder per task before and after the due date.
notifications.platformOff: Email delivery is not yet set up on this platform.
notifications.noEmail: Your account has no email address.

todo_new.label: New tasks
todo_new.hint: Bundled email when you get new tasks. Tasks from a protocol arrive once it is closed.

todo_reminders.label: Task reminders
todo_reminders.hint: Once 3 days before the due date and once the day after, if still open.

fines.label: Fines
fines.hint: “Fine ahead” 3 days before a to-do with a fine is due (instead of the normal reminder), and an email when fines are charged to you.

todo_submissions.label: Submission received
todo_submissions.hint: When a submission in the drop box completes your submission task.

submission_changes.label: Changes to submissions
submission_changes.hint: When a responsible person withdraws their submission using their personal link. Only for people who manage submissions.

exports.label: Data export ready
exports.hint: Only if you request an organization data export: an email once it is ready or has failed.

notifications.securityNote: Security notices (password or second factor changed) and password reset links are always sent.

docs.security: More about password and second factor

logoutPendingConfirm: There are unsaved changes. Signing out discards them on this device.

hub.title: Settings
hub.description: Everything that defines how hocX works for {tenant}.
hub.linksWithoutExpiry: {count, plural, one {# access link never expires} other {# access links never expire}}
hub.linksWithoutExpiryHint: Links without an expiry date stay valid until someone revokes them.

status.modules: {count, plural, =0 {No modules booked} one {# module active} other {# modules active}}
status.publicLinks: {count, plural, =0 {No active access links} one {# active access link} other {# active access links}}

sessionTemplates.description: Minutes templates, building blocks and the working year of your meetings.

taskPackages.description: Recurring tasks bundled into packages you assign to a meeting.

fineSettings.description: Attendance fines, rates and rules for task fines.

users.description: Roles, who can access what, and security rules for logins.

documentTemplates.description: How minutes, lists and other documents look as PDF.

documentBrand.description: Colours, fonts, logo and images for all documents.

domainsAndVerification.description: Custom domains for hocX and the drop box, document authenticity check.

organisationProfile.description: Name, profile picture, currency and special fields of events.

privacy.description: Privacy notice, statistics, visibility and retention.

publicLinks.description: Every way someone can reach your organisation's data without signing in.

sharedLinks.description: Shared files, albums and documents with a public link.

import.description: Bring in minutes and data from Word and other sources.
